sentences.text: Distance is measured on the latitude scale, the one running up the sides of the chart, where one minute of latitude equals one nautical mile.
Set the dividers on the two points, then carry them to the side scale at about the same latitude and read the minutes and tenths.
On a Mercator chart, the latitude scale stretches as you go north, so always use the part of the scale level with your work.
Never measure distance on the longitude scale across the top or bottom of the chart.
